definitions.explanation: The kind of person one is attracted to.

examples.japanese: {好|この}みは{人|ひと}それぞれだ。
examples.english: Preferences differ from person to person.

examples.japanese: お{好|この}みでソースをかけてください。
examples.english: Please add sauce according to your preference.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{私|わたし}の{好|この}みのタイプだ。
{音楽|おんがく}の{好|この}みは{年齢|ねんれい}とともに{変|か}わることがある。{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}{好|す}きだった{曲|きょく}を{今|いま}も{聴|き}くかどうかは{人|ひと}による。
examples.english: Musical tastes can change with age. Whether one still listens to songs they liked when young depends on the person.

notes:
{好|この}み expresses personal preferences and tastes.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- お{好|この}みで (according to your preference)
- 〜{好|この}み (liking ~)
- {好|この}みに{合|あ}う (to suit one's taste)
- {好|この}みが{分|わ}かれる (tastes differ)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{好|この}み{焼|や}き (okonomiyaki - 'as you like it' savory pancake)
- {好|この}みのタイプ (one's type of person)
- {個人|こじん}の{好|この}み (personal preference)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {好|この}み: preference (personal taste)
- {趣味|しゅみ}: hobby, taste (aesthetic sense)
- {好|す}き: liking (general)
